newsitem.title: CHINA: Malaysia's Mahathir forges ties with China visit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir forges ties with China visit.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Tuesday wrapped up a three-day visit to China that forged several business deals.

China's state media hailed the visit and quoted Chinese President Jiang Zemin as telling Mahathir that China posed no threat to other nations, and that a new international political order would emerge in the next century.
"Nations need cooperation, not confrontation; they need contact, not containment; they need dialogue, not a resort to force," the Communist Party newspaper People's Daily quoted Jiang as saying.
During his visit Mahathir met with Jiang and Chinese Premier Li Peng and attended the signings of several pacts between Chinese and Malaysian firms.
Among the deals were initial contracts between Chinese, Malaysian and Japanese companies for the establishment of two joint venture engine factories in China.
